title: Engine frame rate limiter active (headroom available)
fix_rationale: The trace shows the engine spent excess time sleeping inside FEngineLoop_UpdateTimeAndHandleMaxTickRate to respect the target frame rate limit (e.g. t.MaxFPS). This indicates performance headroom rather than a bottleneck.
evidence_template: The engine spent {ms} ms sleeping inside {timer} to adhere to frame rate limits.

fixes.text: No optimization required: idle sleep confirms the hardware easily meets the current frame rate target.
If higher framerates are desired, increase or disable the frame limiter (e.g. t.MaxFPS 0 in console or Project Settings).

verify: Adjust t.MaxFPS and confirm that frame times scale with the new framerate ceiling.
caveats: This is an informational signal indicating performance headroom, not a performance issue.
